answer: Farming becomes a vertex bet on surviving 62 epochs of grading, and every vine settlement recomputes the dawn schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 7 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 62 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
